name: get_vercel_ci_invocation_logs
description:
Get log lines for a Vercel CI invocation attempt, optionally filtered by log level.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/vercel-ci/invocations/{invocationId}/attempts/{attempt}/logs --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

level.description: Only return log lines with one of these levels.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
